question: To which of the following corporate houses does the leading vaccine manufacturing company Serum Institute of India Private Limited belong?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cyrus Poonawalla Group.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cyrus Poonawalla Group is the corporate house of the leading vaccine manufacturing company Serum Institute of India Private Limited belong.**
 
• Serum Institute of India Pvt. Ltd. is now the world's largest vaccine manufacturer by the number of doses produced and sold globally (more than 1.5 billion doses) which includes Polio vaccine as well as Diphtheria, Tetanus, Pertussis, Hib, BCG, r-Hepatitis B, Measles, Mumps, and Rubella vaccines.
 
• Serum Institute of India begins production of Covovax vaccine.
 
• The company is already locally producing the Covishield vaccine developed by Oxford University and AstraZeneca.(AP).
 
• Serum Institute of India was founded in **1966 by Dr. Cyrus Poonawalla.**
 
• **Its Headquarters** is located in** Hadapsar, Pune, Maharashtra.**
 
• **CEO**- Mr Adar Poonawalla.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Adani Group:**

 
 
• It has taken over the responsibilities of the Jaipur International Airport from the Airports Authority of India (AAI).
 
• The airport has been leased out to the group by the government of India for a period of 50 years.
 
• Jaipur airport is the 11th busiest airport in India in daily scheduled flight operations.
 
• Recently, Adani Enterprises arm Adani Airport Holdings (AAHL) has taken over the management control of a series of airports in India including the Mumbai International Airport Ltd (MIAL).
 
• Adani Group has also won competitive bids to run the airports in, Ahmedabad, Guwahati, Lucknow, Mangalore, and Thiruvananthapuram.
